title: The Crab and the Twig
lines: Beth and Raj dig a pit in wet sand.
Then a small crab jumps up from the sand!
Beth claps and steps back fast.
Raj said, "A crab can pinch. Do not grab."
The crab grabs a stick and slips off.
It hid in a crack next to a rock.
Beth taps the crack. The crab did not shift.
Then Raj sticks a twig in the flat sand.
The crab grabs it and drags it off.
Beth and Raj grin. "He wants that stick!"

questions.ask: Why does Raj say not to grab the crab?
questions.listenFor: A crab can pinch. It is right there in his talking - have them find the quote marks.

questions.ask: Beth taps the crack with the crab in it. Does the crab come out?
questions.listenFor: No - it did not shift. Line seven says it. That is the try that does not work.

questions.ask: Find the line that shows the crab wanted the stick. Read it to me.
questions.listenFor: The line where the crab grabs the twig and drags it off. Let them hunt for the word grabs.
